title: Pocketwire Business Profile Instant Payout Velocity Keep-Back
content:
Velocity rule of the fraud team for the Pocketwire Business Profile. The instant velocity keep-back is 400.00 dollars when at least 4 instant card payouts are dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date, 150.00 dollars when at least 2 but fewer than 4 are, and nothing when fewer are. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Instant card payouts dated in the rolling month | Instant velocity keep-back |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | USD 400.00 |
| 2 or 3 | USD 150.00 |
| 0 or 1 | none |

Only payouts to a debit card count toward this rule; standard bank payouts and payouts to the owner's personal balance do not.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Three instant card payouts and two bank payouts in the rolling month: USD 150.00. Four instant card payouts: USD 400.00.
